patthana18.11:1.1: Hetusampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetusampayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi.
patthana18.11:2.1: Hetuvippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetuvippayutto nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… tīṇi… hetuyā cha.
patthana18.11:3.1: Hetusampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nahetuvippayutto nanahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
